item.title: MSA adds ballot measure regarding participation in Workers Rights Consortium
item.description: A lone bill proposing a ballot initiative for the University of Missouri to re-enter the Workers Rights Consortium (WRC) was passed with no opposition on Tuesday at the Missouri Student Association’s full Senate meeting.
